note: A variable's schema absorbs `get datacolumns`: twins of cli_scope/datacolumns-explicit-reference, cli_scope/datacolumns-unheld-explicit-reference, logical/datacolumns-holdings and logical/get_datacolumns-unheld-holdings. Reference lists every delivered column over both variants; holdings only the held 2018 and 2019 representations (in their delivered spellings); an unheld variable is not found in holdings; `variant` keeps one variant's rows, and a well-formed slug no variant has keeps none (a filter, not a ref); every row carries the variable's concept group. Fails if holdings leaks a reference-only column (Secret, Valørarkiv), an unheld variable resolves in holdings, `variant` stops filtering, an unknown variant is refused instead of filtering, or a row loses its group.
